notes.title: Check Out the Latest Trailer for Lost Hellden!
notes.content:
[h3]Is your greatest Sin that you always miss the latest trailers?

Don’t worry, we’ve got you covered.

If you weren’t able to catch it during the Future Games Show earlier today, here’s a first look at our brand new trailer for Lost Hellden 👇[/h3]

[previewyoutube=Kgks1tXS6bk;full][/previewyoutube]

Lost Hellden is a classically inspired action JRPG set in a gorgeous hand-painted 3D world, featuring illustrations by Takeshi Oga ([i]Gravity Rush[/i], [i]Siren[/i]) and a soundtrack by Hitoshi Sakimoto ([i]Final Fantasy XII[/i], [i]Final Fantasy Tactics[/i], [i]Valkyria Chronicles[/i]). Follow eight highly customisable characters on a journey through Era and beyond, and master a phased battle system that balances real-time and turn-based combat.

Set in the beautifully realized world of Era, Lost Hellden follows Cyphel and his twin brother Leht. When their binding ritual fails, Cyphel is born without sin and Leht is bound to all seven. According to the religion of Unio, the people of Era must live their lives bound to one of the Seven Deadly Sins. Those who resist their urges are promised eternity in the sacred land of Hellden. But for those who succumb, a fate worse than death awaits. 

After years of being hidden away in the Unio Temple, Leht escapes and is determined to overcome his unique predicament. Cyphel must leave the safety of the temple to find him and is thus thrust into a world of monsters, rebels, and celestial conspiracy. Lost Hellden tells a rich story of self-discovery, family, and fate, fully voiced in Japanese and English.

We also revealed during the Future Games Show that we’ve partnered with UK-based publisher Kwalee to release Lost Hellden!

notes.title: Final Fantasy devs’ Lost Hellden boasts 3D handpainted art and a mix of action and strategy in a gorgeous JRPG
notes.content:
A group of developers with credits across a number of Final Fantasy games - including the composer of Final Fantasy XII and a former Final Fantasy XIV artist - have unveiled their own upcoming JRPG headed to PC next year.

notes.title: Prepare to lose yourself in Lost Hellden, the new hand-painted JRPG from Final Fantasy and Valkyrie Chronicles veterans
notes.content:
Artisan Studios has announced the development of a lovely hand-painted JRPG titled Lost Hellden.

The studio is made up of developers who previously worked on the Final Fantasy and Valkyria Chronicles franchises to name a few.
